nodes.label: Sending is_superuser=true on user creation must be silently ignored (SEC-002).
A client-role user (no manage_users permission) cannot create users.
The public, unauthenticated signup endpoint must no longer exist (SEC-001).
Sending is_superuser=true on user update must be silently ignored (SEC-002).
Admins must still be able to change a user's role (SEC-002 regression guard).
A client-role user (no manage_users permission) cannot delete users.
Changing a user's role via PATCH clears their permission overrides.
Updating a user WITHOUT changing role does NOT clear permissions.
